thread:
Nora: short convo: Console needs to explain why requests jump to fallback capacity and how that ties to auth source (org/project/sa). support tickets keep coming in.
Eli: totally. we currently only see final model id in billing metrics. no auth-origin attribution.
Priya: proposal: auth resolver attaches an internal-only header `x-rwd-auth-path` and `x-rwd-auth-hash` to the request envelope. headers emitted by auth-proxy so hot path is cheap.
Jun: agree but we must be careful about cardinality. sampling plan: start at 0.1% debug -> 1% canary -> 10% canary -> full.
Sam: Console UX idea: per-route "Auth origin" small tile + an "Explain" flyout that shows the decision tree (token vs exchange vs fallback) and a link to trace.
Nora: also want a global rollup that breaks down cost and tokens by auth_bucket, model_variant, region. filters for timeframe and customer tier.
Eli: metric naming suggestion: `routing.auth_origin.tokens` (counter) with labels `auth_bucket`, `model_variant`, `region`. emit sampled metrics only.
Priya: implementation detail: don't put PII in labels. hash SA emails and use short stable ids like `sa_h:1a2b`. maintain full mapping only in secure traces.
Jun: infra constraints: enforce metric cardinality cap = 100, retention hot = 30d, archive beyond. add feature flag `auth_origin_tagging` to toggle sampling.
Sam: UX: tile shows top-10 auth buckets; "Other" buckets folded. clicking a bucket opens the explain flyout with last-resolved trace id.
Nora: alerting: page if top auth_bucket token rate delta >20% v baseline for 5m, or unique auth_bucket count spikes >150% in 1h.
Eli: add a monitor on metric cardinality approaching cap and on metric emission errors.
Priya: code snippet for proxy to add header (pseudo):
```
// in auth-proxy
if (featureFlags.auth_origin_tagging.enabled && sampleRequest()) {
  req.headers['x-rwd-auth-path'] = authPathEnum;
  req.headers['x-rwd-auth-hash'] = sha256(authId).slice(0,8);
}
```
Jun: keep sampling deterministic per-client for easier debuggability (hash client id + sampler seed).
Sam: docs: internal playbook + support FAQ. Public changelog: vague line "improved internal routing telemetry" only.
Nora: perf safety net: if we see SLO regressions, flip sampling to 0 and rollback proxy. ops-bot: "deploy queued: auth-proxy v2 -> canary 5%"
deploy-bot: "canary deploy started: auth-proxy v2 -> 5%"
Eli: owners: Priya (backend/headers), Jun (infra/perf), Sam (Console UX), Nora (PM + rollout), Eli (alerts/monitoring). reconvene in 48h after initial sample.
Nora: thanks all, will add ticket and PR links in the tracker.
